avoid_supplements.name: Carnitine (high-dose supplementation)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Valproate depletes carnitine; excessive supplementation may mask deficiency symptoms or cause imbalance
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor carnitine levels; use only under clinical guidance if supplementation needed

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP450 enzymes, reducing valproate levels and efficacy; also increases seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; do not initiate without consulting prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxic; combined with valproate increases risk of severe liver injury
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; educate patient to avoid completely

caution_supplements.name: Folate/Folic Acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Valproate interferes with folate metabolism; supplementation may help but requires monitoring
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation under clinical guidance; monitor folate levels periodically

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Valproate increases metabolism of vitamin D, potentially causing deficiency
caution_supplements.action: Periodic monitoring and supplementation may be warranted; assess at baseline and annually

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12
caution_supplements.mechanism: Valproate may reduce B12 absorption; deficiency possible with long-term use
caution_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels annually; supplement if deficiency develops

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (large quantity consumed at once)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May delay valproate absorption and reduce peak serum levels; affects drug efficacy timing
avoid_foods.action: Take valproate consistently with or without food; avoid erratic dietary fat intake

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increases sedation risk; chronic use induces hepatic metabolism
caution_foods.action: Counsel to minimize or avoid alcohol; assess impact on seizure control if consumed

caution_foods.name: Caffeinated beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase CNS stimulation, potentially affecting seizure threshold or anxiety levels
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; limit excessive caffeine intake and maintain consistent consumption

monitoring_notes: Monitor liver function, ammonia levels, and blood counts regularly, especially in first 6 months. Assess carnitine, folate, vitamin D, and B12 status periodically as valproate depletes or interferes with these nutrients; supplement as clinically indicated.
